flows.name: Deactivate one person
flows.goal: Remove access for someone who has left, keeping their learning history.
flows.user: An Admin at a 500-person hotel group.
flows.entry: Admin › People & Teams › People, Active tab.
flows.success: The person is on the Deactivated tab and can no longer sign in.

steps.title: People
steps.note: The Active tab lists everyone who can access 5Mins, 25 per page. The Admin opens the actions menu on Afonso Adeyemi's row.

steps.title: Actions menu
steps.note: View Profile and Deactivate. Choosing Deactivate opens the confirmation.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.note: The dialog says they lose access straight away but keep their learning history. Deactivate confirms.

steps.title: Deactivated
steps.note: A toast confirms it, the Active count drops by one and the Deactivated count rises by one.

steps.title: Deactivated tab
steps.note: The person is listed with the date. Their actions menu offers Reactivate.

flows.name: Invite people
flows.user: An Admin at a 500-person hotel group.
flows.success: The toast confirms how many invites were sent.

steps.title: People
steps.note: Invite People in the page header opens the invite modal.

steps.title: Invite modal
steps.note: The Admin pastes one or more email addresses. Send Invites stays disabled until there's at least one.

steps.title: Invites sent
steps.note: A toast says how many invites were sent, and the modal closes.
